+def make_response(content=b'', status_code=200, encoding=None):
+    response = requests.Response()
+    response.status_code = status_code
+    response._content = content
+    response.encoding = encoding
+    return response
+
+
+def test_urlopen_keep_trying_retries_and_decodes_utf8(monkeypatch):
+    attempts = [make_response(status_code=500), requests.exceptions.ConnectionError(),
+                make_response(b'\xc3\xa9')]
+    calls = []
+    sleeps = []
+
+    def fake_get(url, **kwargs):
+        calls.append((url, kwargs))
+        result = attempts.pop(0)
+        if isinstance(result, Exception):
+            raise result
+        return result
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(get_ia.requests, 'get', fake_get)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(get_ia, 'sleep', sleeps.append)
+
+    response = get_ia.urlopen_keep_trying('https://example.org/marc.xml',
+                                           headers={'Accept': 'application/xml'}, timeout=5)
+    assert response.text == u'\xe9'
+    assert response.encoding == 'utf-8'
+    assert calls == [('https://example.org/marc.xml',
+                      {'headers': {'Accept': 'application/xml'}, 'timeout': 5})] * 3
+    assert sleeps == [2, 2]
+
+
+def test_urlopen_keep_trying_honors_response_encoding(monkeypatch):
+    expected = make_response(b'\xe9', encoding='iso-8859-1')
+    monkeypatch.setattr(get_ia.requests, 'get', lambda url, **kwargs: expected)
+
+    response = get_ia.urlopen_keep_trying('https://example.org/marc.xml')
+    assert response.text == u'\xe9'
+    assert response.encoding == 'iso-8859-1'
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize('status_code', [403, 404, 416])
+def test_urlopen_keep_trying_raises_terminal_http_errors(monkeypatch, status_code):
+    calls = []
+
+    def fake_get(url, **kwargs):
+        calls.append(url)
+        return make_response(status_code=status_code)
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(get_ia.requests, 'get', fake_get)
+    with pytest.raises(requests.exceptions.HTTPError) as error:
+        get_ia.urlopen_keep_trying('https://example.org/marc.xml')
+    assert error.value.response.status_code == status_code
+    assert len(calls) == 1
+
+
